defs.def: something that you want to do or achieve very much 追求的目标；夙愿

ex.s: Our brains can form multiple long-term goals and ambitions.
ex.t: 五年前我开始转向零浪费生活方式时就经历了这种情况，当时我和父母住在一起；现在我和丈夫一起生活时也继续经历这种情况，因为他并不像我一样完全零浪费。

ex.s: DM, a company focused on the development of A GI, has an ambition to “solve intelligence”.
ex.t: 一家专注于开发AGI的公司DM有一个"解决智能"的雄心。

ex.s: No one will ever know what mix of talent, ambition, energy and luck made Dickens such a singular writer.
ex.t: 但随着他200周年诞辰的临近，理解他如何使自己成为不朽的人物——这对我们自己的文化来说是可能的且重要的。

defs.def: the desire or determination to be successful, rich, powerful, etc. 野心；雄心；志向；抱负

ex.s: The American author, Ernest Hemingway, born in 1899, was from early boyhood single-minded in his ambition to write.
ex.t: 美国作家欧内斯特·海明威（ Ernest Hemingway ）出生于1899年，他从小就一心一意地想写作。

ex.s: But Doyle’s main ambition was to become a writer of historical novels.
ex.t: 但多伊尔的主要目标是成为历史小说作家。

ex.s: Eugénie Grandet Eugénie Grandet is a novel with the dual themes of greed and social ambition at its core.
ex.t: 尤金妮·格兰德（ Eugénie Grandet ）是一部以贪婪和社会野心为核心的双重主题的小说。

ex.s: My ambition is to set up a business in China after graduation,” she explained.
ex.t: 我的目标是毕业后在中国开展业务， ”她解释说。

ex.s: In his opinion, there’s so much that people can achieve with the right and ambition.
ex.t: 在他看来，人们凭借权利和雄心可以实现很多目标。
